learner_operation: Separate the displayed ODE, integrate both sides, invert to an explicit general family, and distinguish the candidate with the correct primitive coefficient or fill the specified solution factor.

fixed_features.feature: First-order separable ODE with elementary primitives and explicit inversion
fixed_features.justification: Tutorials 6766/6767 and all five easy source questions establish this operation; initial-value or harder integration tasks would drift.

fixed_features.feature: Five-choice single-correct radio for easy practice
fixed_features.justification: All captured easy banks have this response contract. Fixing one correct choice is essential; its identity and position are eligible to vary.

fixed_features.feature: One inverse family within each fresh coefficient-peer bank
fixed_features.justification: The intended integration/inversion is still required to determine its coefficient. Matching the source inverse type alone now leaves five possibilities. Controlled changes make each possible candidate correct; this is a valid focused simplification.

fixed_features.feature: Small signed coefficient palette and bounded translations
fixed_features.justification: Keeps arithmetic and elementary antiderivative workload comparable to the source. Palette size is not claimed as comprehensive mastery; both signs and every candidate role are tested.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Each supported signed candidate can satisfy the displayed ODE while the same bank remains fixed.
answer_roles.observed: Five distinct targets per easy template, all surviving delivery; additional tan a=5 and h boundaries tested.

answer_roles.role: Correct radio position and distractor expression
answer_roles.eligible_variation: May change independently of mathematical response; no label or UI position is intrinsic.
answer_roles.observed: Seed-only pairs preserve mathematical response; source banks replay and fresh UI positions vary. Live task IDs are unavailable.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Signed ODE coefficients change reciprocal/log fragments; temperature rate changes exponential factor, ambient offset does not.
answer_roles.observed: New moderate signed blanks pass visible ODE derivative and native equivalent-entry tests. Ambient-only pair preserves factor.

coverage.case: five easy inverse families, every candidate coefficient role
coverage.result: All 25 controlled cases survive and retain five distinct correct answers in an identical bank per template.

Five accepted, zero duplicates; reciprocal cube 3, cube power 1, log 1; two negative and three positive coefficients. Old shape cue determines none. This batch is limited practice, not coverage of all five families.

coverage.case: source and newly restored blank families
coverage.result: 14 complete banks replay; signed reciprocal/log blanks and rate/ambient cases independently checked.

counterfactuals.change: For each easy template, coefficient a=-1 becomes a=2 with translation, other coefficients, seed and complete bank held fixed.
counterfactuals.expected: ODE, primitive, explicit correct family and keyed response change; previous answer must be rejected.
counterfactuals.observed: All five pairs update together. Exact derivative checks, rendered prompts/solutions and native stale-answer rejection pass.
counterfactuals.justification: Source tutorials require integrating h(x); scaling h changes its primitive and explicit solution coefficient.

counterfactuals.change: Change shuffle seed only, and separately change temperature ambient 25 to 35 at fixed decay rate.
counterfactuals.expected: Seed changes preserve equation/solution/answer; ambient changes displayed offset and full solution but preserve requested exponential factor.
counterfactuals.observed: All five seed pairs and ambient pair pass content comparisons and actual native acceptance; full ambient render updates while factor remains e^(-0.03t).
counterfactuals.justification: Choice order does not enter the differential equation. Source q-168077 integrates dT/(T-ambient)=-rate dt; ambient disappears from the requested factor.

delivery.result: 46 raw independent records become 45 after one duplicate; all controlled coefficient cases survive. Actual batch remains 5/5. Unchanged selector uses no template/answer features; positive easy weights preserve reachability. Read-only pipeline, zero database writes.

limitations: Finite focused revision review does not prove absence of every shortcut or certify all authored hard extensions.
No publication preparation exists. Delivery reproduced read-only at captured inventory basis 5366; future inventory may change duplicates.

Real learner history, future entity/task IDs and policy weights are unavailable. Selector mechanics examined and reproduced with synthetic IDs; exact live selection/position frequencies are not claimed.
The five-record batch is not exhaustive family coverage; repeated practice can draw further varied signed cases. Singleton batch template subgroups do not justify a universal predictor.

One historical generated easy inventory item retains the original shortcut. It was reproduced completely and reported in affected-inventory.json; it is not produced by the current construction, and no database repair was performed.
